title: the familiar, again
label: after landfall
paragraphs: 在海上飘了二十天，上岸后对所有事都宽容且感激。见到了几年没见的一直崇拜的朋友，说了很多很多，enough for what would normally take a month.

i had understood curiosity as a hunger for distance: unfamiliar shores, the migration of winds, the architecture of currents, everything that could prove the world larger than the portion of it i already knew. after landfall, a conversation could produce the same feeling. here was someone familiar, and still a life i could not see to the bottom of.

in the odyssey, penelope's test of the returning stranger turns on a bed built around an olive tree rooted in the ground. the account of that particular construction lets her recognize her husband. after all the distances of the poem, something known between two people has remained in place.

i keep thinking about the patience inside that recognition. the friend across from me had lived whole years while i was elsewhere. familiarity could make me careless about those years, as though knowing a person once excused me from finding out who was here now. we kept talking. i wanted to hear what i had missed.
the pacific had occupied every visible direction. back on land, the world exceeded me at the width of a table.
终于吃上了火锅！感恩梅花猪、雪花牛、鸡蛋面、鸭血、毛肚、蘑菇、豆皮、虾滑、蓬蒿、菠菜、油条，还有小料台和水果，一切除了金枪鱼罐头之外的食物。
